questions.stem: What is the key difference between Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes?

options.text: Type 1 is caused by obesity while Type 2 is an autoimmune disease
In Type 1, the pancreas does not produce insulin; in Type 2, the body's cells do not respond properly to insulin
Type 1 only affects adults while Type 2 only affects children
Type 1 can be cured by diet while Type 2 requires insulin injections

questions.explanation: In Type 1 diabetes, the pancreas produces no insulin. In Type 2 diabetes, the pancreas still produces insulin but the body's cells become resistant to it, or insufficient insulin is produced.
